name: Tarrés (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow central pale flanked on each side by a narrow white pale.
history: The official flag of Tarrés is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with a central yellow pale of width 2/9 of the width of the cloth, with two white pales of width 1/18 on each side, each separated by 1/18 from the yellow pale.

features.role: central yellow pale of 2/9 with a narrow white pale on each side
